payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates i from 1 to k, computes n%i, uses hash map to detect duplicates, early exits on duplicate or i>1e7.
payload.rationale: Solution performs exhaustive search over possible i values, with a dictionary to check distinctness. Early break on duplicate or limit resembles a backtracking-like search with pruning, fitting search_backtracking subtype within complete_search family.
